message.content:
Move the `Value` struct and its entire `impl Value` block out of src/lib.rs into a new module file src/value.rs. Here is the proposal for the changes:

### src/lib.rs
Edit proposal to remove the `Value` struct and its `impl` block from `src/lib.rs`:
```json
{
    "name": "edit-as-proposal",
    "arguments": {
        "path": "src/lib.rs",
        "start_line": 10,
        "end_line": 37,
        "new_str": "",
        "proposal_title": "Move Value struct and impl to src/value.rs",
        "proposal_reason": "Refactor Value struct and its impl to a new module file."
    }
}
```

### src/value.rs
Create new file `src/value.rs` with the `Value` struct and its `impl` block:
```json
{
    "name": "edit-as-proposal",
    "arguments": {
        "path": "src/value.rs",
        "start_line": null,
        "end_line": null,
        "new_str": "/// A single configuration value, stored as raw text with typed accessors.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Value {\n    raw: String,\n}\n\nimpl Value {\n    /// Wrap raw value text.\n    pub fn new(raw: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        Value { raw: raw.into() }\n    }\n\n    /// The raw text of the value, as written in the source.\n    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.raw\n    }\n\n    /// Parse the value as a signed integer.\n    pub fn as_int(&self) -> Option<i64> {\n        self.raw.parse().ok()\n    }\n\n    /// Parse the value as a boolean. Accepts `true`/`false`, `yes`/`no`,\n    /// and `on`/`off`, case-insensitively.\n    pub fn as_bool(&self) -> Option<bool> {\n        match self.raw.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {\n            \"true\" | \"yes\" | \"on\" => Some(true),\n            \"false\" | \"no\" | \"off\" => Some(false),\n            _ => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n",
        "proposal_title": "Add Value struct and impl to src/value.rs",
        "proposal_reason": "Refactor Value struct and its impl to a new module file."
    }
}
```

### src/lib.rs
Edit proposal to add the `mod value;` declaration and update the `pub use` statement:
```json
{
    "name": "edit-as-proposal",
    "arguments": {
        "path": "src/lib.rs",
        "start_line": 3,
        "end_line": 3,
        "new_str": "mod value;\npub use value::Value;\n",
        "proposal_title": "Add mod declaration and pub use for Value",
        "proposal_reason": "Update lib.rs to import Value from the new value module."
    }
}
```

### src/value.rs
Edit proposal to add the `mod value;` declaration and update the `pub use` statement:
```json
{
    "name": "edit-as-proposal",
    "arguments": {
        "path": "src/value.rs",
        "start_line": 1,
        "end_line": 1,
        "new_str": "pub mod value;\n",
        "proposal_title": "Add mod declaration for value module",
        "proposal_reason": "Declare the value module."
    }
}
```

These proposals will ensure that the `Value` struct and its implementation are moved to a new module file `src/value.rs`, and the necessary changes are made to `src/lib.rs` to include and use this new module.
